description: Deliver the LLM-first fantasy RPG asset foundry MVP
deviation_notes: Implementation consolidated into one vertical-slice commit instead of task-sized commits; the completion audit added one Review Fixes task and one Owner Evidence Review Fixes task; subagent roles were assigned as requested but the collaboration runtime did not expose model attestation; agent-browser CLI was unavailable so the committed source-isolated Playwright acceptance path was used.

sprint.goal: Deliver a local LLM-first vertical slice that creates, revises, validates, renders, and exports constrained stylized fantasy RPG assets from canonical semantic documents without Blender.
sprint.demo_notes: Automated acceptance complete. Explicit owner review of interactive 3D and actual-resolution sprites remains required.
